title: NetworkZone
description: Definition of a named network zone used by enterprise private networking and project-aware networking (spec sections 35-36). Zone names are the snake_case keys that manifests and policies reference ('internet', 'corp_dev', 'corp_prod', spec sections 17, 20, 36); the section 36 tables show their display names ('Internet', 'Acme Dev', 'Production', 'Privileged DB'). Runtime JSON record: snake_case fields, strict.
$comment: Network observability records (spec section 37, 'punarctl privacy connections': process, destination, reason, relay route, project, AI session association) are runtime telemetry, deliberately OUT of the v1alpha1 contract layer. Milestone 3 note: crates/punar-common Rust types are not yet reconciled with this schema.

name.title: Zone name
name.description: Stable snake_case identifier for the zone, e.g. 'internet', 'corp_dev', 'corp_prod', 'privileged_db'. These are the zone keys used in ProjectEnvironment and AI policy manifests (spec sections 17, 20) and referenced by project network policies (spec section 36).

display_name.title: Display name
display_name.description: Human-readable label shown in UI tables, e.g. 'Acme Dev', 'Production', 'Privileged DB' (spec section 36).

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of what the zone covers, e.g. which destinations belong to it ('dev.api.acme.internal', spec section 35).

kind.title: Zone kind
kind.description: Category of the zone (spec sections 35-36): 'internet' = public internet egress; 'corporate' = enterprise private development networks (Acme Dev / corp_dev); 'production' = production networks (corp_prod); 'privileged' = privileged resources such as the section 36 'Privileged DB'.

relay_mode.title: Relay mode
relay_mode.description: Default routing mode for traffic bound for this zone, per the spec section 33 diagram (Punar Network Policy -> Private Relay / Enterprise Route / Direct). Optional; when absent the routing decision is left to runtime network policy.

zone_name.title: Zone name
zone_name.description: Snake_case zone identifier (spec sections 17, 20, 36). Matches manifest zone keys such as 'internet', 'corp_dev', 'corp_prod'.

zone_kind.title: Zone kind
zone_kind.description: Zone categories derived from the spec section 36 tables and section 35 enterprise private networking: internet, corporate (enterprise dev), production, privileged.

relay_mode.title: Relay mode
relay_mode.description: How eligible traffic is routed (spec section 33): 'direct' = no relay; 'private_relay' = the native (long-term dual-hop, spec section 34) private relay; 'enterprise_route' = enterprise private networking route (spec section 35).
